claim.statement: 市场结构、趋势、支撑阻力和突破判断必须绑定时间周期、bar start/end、bar confirmation 和数据可用时点；不得把未确认的高周期 K 线当成已知事实。
claim.evidence_summary: QuantConnect states that bars have start and end times and are passed to algorithms at end time to avoid unavailable-bar lookahead.; TradingView documents higher/lower timeframe data requests and behavior differences between historical and realtime bars.; TradingView explains repainting and historical versus realtime behavior for script calculations.
claim.interpretation_notes: 本候选只定义 K线/策略工程方法边界，不输出买卖点、仓位、杠杆、止损止盈参数或实盘执行建议。

AI Engineering 只能引用本规则，不得把本规则改写为 LLM 训练、MCP、RAG 或模型部署本体规则。
assumptions: 候选用于 CEK-TA 通用支持层知识库，而不是某个项目私有交易系统配置。
所有 K线/策略工程结论必须保留市场、周期、数据、成本、样本和验证边界。
候选通过外部审计前不能进入正式 reviewed 知识库。
limitations: 本批来源包含论文、专业机构综述、交易平台文档和技术库文档，仍需要外部 AI/人工严格审计来源强度。
平台/框架文档只能支撑工程边界和例子，不能替代具体交易所、数据供应商或外接项目策略契约。
本候选不提供任何投资建议或实盘执行许可。

source_refs.evidence_summary: QuantConnect states that bars have start and end times and are passed to algorithms at end time to avoid unavailable-bar lookahead.
limitations: LEAN-specific time model; external projects must map equivalent bar availability semantics.

source_refs.evidence_summary: TradingView documents higher/lower timeframe data requests and behavior differences between historical and realtime bars.
limitations: Pine Script-specific implementation source; use for multi-timeframe/repainting caveats, not universal platform requirements.

source_refs.evidence_summary: TradingView explains repainting and historical versus realtime behavior for script calculations.
limitations: Platform-specific; supports the need to document bar confirmation and realtime/historical semantics.

source_refs.evidence_summary: CFA Institute discusses technical analysis, trend, support/resistance, indicators, oscillators, volume and risk-management context.
limitations: Professional overview; formal candidates still need explicit market, timeframe, data and validation boundaries.
正式入库前必须由外部审计确认 claim 没有超出来源可证明范围。
教育、平台和框架文档只能作为 supporting evidence，不能单独证明交易信号有效性。
